2:238.text: prayer and stand before Allāh, devoutly obedient.

2:239.text: on foot or riding. But when you are secure, then remember Allāh
, as He has taught you that which you did not

2:240.text: And those who are taken in death among you and leave wives behind - for their wives is a bequest: maintenance for one year without turning
, then there is no blame upon you for what they do with themselves in an acceptable way.
And Allāh is Exalted in Might and Wise.

2:241.text: And for divorced women is a provision according to what is acceptable - a duty upon the righteous.

2:242.text: Thus does Allāh make clear to you His verses

2:243.text: Have you not considered those who left their homes in many thousands, fearing death? Allāh said to them, "Die"; then He restored them to life. And Allāh is the possessor of bounty for the people, but most of the people do not show gratitude.

2:244.text: And fight in the cause of Allāh and know that Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.

2:245.text: Who is it that would loan Allāh a goodly loan so He may multiply it for him many times over? And it is Allāh who withholds and grants abundance, and to Him you will be returned.
